end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes through familiar examples and asked Ishita to describe their features. Ishita explained the cylinder’s two flat circular ends and curved part, and distinguished a flat cake from a ball-shaped sphere. No shape mix-up was recorded or needing correction later. At home, ask Ishita to find and name one example of each shape around the house, such as a can, ball, box or party hat.
